title: Crown & Charter — accelerated gameplay
captureMethod: Sequential screenshots from the actual running browser game, with each capture timestamp recorded.
isolation: A separate localhost demo origin; the existing 127.0.0.1 saved world was not loaded or changed.
note: 32× is the game simulation setting. Captured frames are retimed at 2× their measured cadence. Pauses between views are omitted. There is no fabricated game footage or interpolated game state.
